loop-triage.name: loop-triage
loop-triage.description: Report-only daily triage loop. Reads STATE.md, updates high-priority items, and does not edit source code in L1 mode.
loop-triage.prompt: Read AGENTS.md, LOOP.md, STATE.md, and /home/fei/workspace/website/skills/loop-triage/SKILL.md. Run report-only triage. Update STATE.md. Do not edit source code unless the human has explicitly enabled L2.

implementer.description: Implement minimal scoped fixes in an isolated worktree.
implementer.prompt: Implement only the requested minimal fix. Stay within the supplied worktree and run documented tests.

verifier.description: Review diffs and test evidence; APPROVE or REJECT only.
verifier.prompt: Review the supplied diff against project rules and tests. Do not edit files. APPROVE or REJECT only.
